header: The last six ratings left by customers, in the order they arrived
lead: Every review here was left by a house with a live licence. We publish them unsorted and unedited, which is why the two-star one is second.
note: Reviews are collected once a year by Softwarelotse and passed to us as they were written. We can neither delete nor reorder them, and the average on this page is recalculated nightly from the same feed.

reviews.quote_text: Four years, two warehouse moves and one takeover later, still the only piece of software here that nobody has asked to replace.
reviews.author: Katrin Weissgruber

reviews.quote_text: Bought it on the strength of the demo, then spent six weeks discovering that our own article data was the problem. Support said so on day two and we did not listen. Docking two stars from myself, really.
reviews.author: Stefan Aigner

reviews.quote_text: Does what it says. The reports are the weak part — I still pull the year-end figures into a spreadsheet to get the layout our accountant wants.
reviews.author: Ines Kofler

reviews.quote_text: Two of us, one shop, and it never once made us feel like we were the wrong size of customer. The price has gone up twice and both times they wrote to explain why.
reviews.author: Lena Brandtner

reviews.quote_text: Solid, unexciting, and I mean that as praise. The mobile view of the reorder list could use a rethink.
reviews.author: Doris Ebner

reviews.quote_text: The handhelds took some getting used to and the barcode setup ate an afternoon. Since then the counting has simply stopped being an event.
reviews.author: Tobias Reisinger
